concerns.text: T013 (GEO Download) and T014 (Feasibility Gate) are marked [P] (parallel-safe) but contain hard sequential dependencies and shared state writes. T013 iterates through IDs and writes to a shared state file (`state/...yaml`) inside the loop. T014 reads the result of T013 (`valid_geo_count`) to make a halt decision. These cannot run in parallel; T014 must strictly follow T013. The [P] tag is incorrect and creates a race condition risk.

T016 (Batch Correction) is marked [P] but explicitly depends on T017c (VST Normalization) and must run before T020 (Split). The task description lists 'Dependency: Runs after T017c', yet the [P] tag implies it can run in parallel with other Phase 3 tasks. This violates the producer-consumer ordering: T017c produces the VST matrix required by T016.

T023d (Orchestrate LOO Loop) is marked [P] but orchestrates a sequential loop (T023a -> T023b -> T023c) for each tumor type. T024c (Aggregate) depends on T023d completing all iterations. Marking the orchestrator as [P] is misleading; the loop itself is inherently sequential per iteration, and the aggregation is strictly post-loop. The [P] tag suggests parallel execution of the loop body which contradicts the 'Orchestrate' nature and the dependency on T023d completion for T024c.

T033 (LOO Validation Pre-Check) is listed after T031a-c in the task list but logically must precede T031 (Model Training) and T032 (Nested CV). The 'Notes' section correctly states 'T033 MUST run before T031/T032', but the task ordering in the list (T031a-c appearing before T033) violates the 'Foundational tasks first' and 'Producer before consumer' principles for the validation flow. T033 is a gate that must block T031.

T012a, T012b, and T012c are all marked [P] but T012c (Write checksums) depends on the successful download and verification in T012b. While they might be in the same file, the logical flow is strictly sequential: Query -> Download/Verify -> Write State. Marking them all as [P] implies they can be executed simultaneously, which is impossible for the state update.
